purpose: 为每个候选池计算 range / tick / bin 维度对 fee proxy 的影响, 输出 narrow/medium/wide 三种 range 的 fee proxy 对比 + 风险标注.

core_principles.G1_required_per_candidate: 每个 selected_for_candidate_review=true 的池都必须有 range_sensitivity 行
core_principles.G2_v3_clmm_three_ranges: V3/CLMM 必须计算 narrow/medium/wide 三种 range 的 fee proxy
core_principles.G3_dlmm_three_bin_coverages: Meteora DLMM 必须计算 narrow/medium/wide 三种 bin coverage 的 fee proxy
core_principles.G4_cpmm_full_range_only: CPMM 池本身就是 full range, 只算 full_range_fee_proxy + lp_share + price_impact + il_proxy
core_principles.G5_range_risk_heuristic: range_risk = low/medium/high, 来自 range_width + in_range_time_ratio + tick_liquidity_density 三者组合的 heuristic
core_principles.G6_confidence_always_low_in_R0: R0 阶段所有 range_sensitivity 行的 fee_estimate_confidence=low (per fee_estimation_without_probe spec)

in_range_time_ratio.description: 窗口内价格在 range 内的时间比例 (R0 近似)

tick_liquidity_density.description: liquidity / tick (or liquidity per sqrt(price) unit)

range_width.description: 本行对应的 range 宽度 (每个候选池应有 3 行: narrow/medium/wide)

range_risk_heuristic.medium: medium range + in_range_time_ratio 0.5-0.8 OR narrow range + in_range_time_ratio >= 0.7
range_risk_heuristic.high: narrow range + in_range_time_ratio < 0.5 OR tick_liquidity_density < 0.1 × median

v3_clmm_range_sensitivity.r0_limitation: R0 不预测未来 in_range_time_ratio, 用窗口内 tick 历史估算; 长期 R0 节点 in_range_time_ratio 可能 0.5 (warning) if 数据不足

active_bin_distance.description: 本池在窗口末 active bin 与窗口初 active bin 的 bin 数差, 表征 volatility

bins_with_liquidity_count.description: active bin 两侧非零 bin 总数

sparse_liquidity_warning.description: true if bins_with_liquidity_count < 5 per side (i.e. < 10 total)

meteora_dlmm_range_sensitivity.r0_limitation: R0 不预测未来 bin drift, 用窗口内 active bin 历史估算; sparse_liquidity 时 narrow/medium bin coverage 风险高

cpmm_range_sensitivity.note: CPMM 池本身就是 full range, 不分 narrow/medium/wide. 只算 full_range_fee_proxy + 风险字段.

price_impact.description: user_notional / pool_tvl (R0 简化; better: 实际 swap-out 模拟)

cpmm_range_sensitivity.r0_limitation: R0 不做实际 swap 模拟, price_impact 简化估算; IL 用 Uniswap V2 标准公式

lst_depeg_history_30d.description: 事件数, R0 来自 on-chain event log

stable_curve_steepness.description: stable pool 的 curve 斜率; flat = 强 stable

reject_criteria: lst_depeg_history_30d > 0 → reject LST-stable 池 (但 stable-stable 池可保留)

sensitivity_summary_per_candidate.purpose: 在 node_report 中对每个 best_candidate 给出一句话 range_sensitivity 总结
sensitivity_summary_per_candidate.template: {pool_address}: narrow_fee=${X} (in_range={Y1}%, risk=Z1), medium_fee=${X2} (in_range={Y2}%, risk=Z2), wide_fee=${X3} (in_range={Y3}%, risk=Z3)
sensitivity_summary_per_candidate.example: 0xABC...: narrow_fee=$0.12 (in_range=42%, risk=high), medium_fee=$0.08 (in_range=78%, risk=medium), wide_fee=$0.04 (in_range=99%, risk=low)

range_risk_aggregation.purpose: 为 candidate_block.best_candidates 提供 aggregate range_risk 评分
range_risk_aggregation.rule: 如果 3 个 range (narrow/medium/wide) 都 high → aggregate_risk=high; 如果至少 1 个 low → aggregate_risk=low (宽 range 可对冲); 其他 → medium

in_range_sensitivity_block.range_assumption_used: all_three_compared (R0 节点必须 3 range 都算)
